values.note: Reservation requests go in by the city's online form (or call City Hall); a request is not confirmed until city staff call back. Seasonal stays need City Council approval.

booking.source: http://inwoodiowa.com/site/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Campground-and-Camper-Policy.pdf ('Reservations may be made for available campsites up to one (1) year in advance'; 'Camping units may occupy a campsite for up to fourteen (14) consecutive days unless otherwise approved by the City Council'; 'Seasonal camping arrangements may be permitted subject to City Council approval') + https://inwoodiowa.com/site/inwood-campground/ ('Submitting a reservation request does not guarantee a campsite ... not confirmed until you have been contacted by the City of Inwood'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: City policy: 'generally' open May 1 through October 15; camping outside the season needs City Council approval.

season.source: http://inwoodiowa.com/site/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Campground-and-Camper-Policy.pdf ('The City campground shall generally be open from May 1 through October 15 each calendar year'; 'Camping or occupancy of campsites outside of the regular campground season is prohibited unless specifically approved by the City Council'), read 2026-11-03

note: City of Inwood's small campground in Foote Park, a shaded lane of four sites off Highway 182 at the south edge of town beside the ballfields. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 4 reservable sites via the city's request form; added season May 1 - Oct 15, 1-year booking window, 14-night limit. No rate posted. Full hookups not confirmed on any city page. Not waterfront, pin OK.
flags: NO RATE posted: neither the campground page, the 2026 policy nor the reservation form gives a nightly fee (matches the 2026-10-11 price pass: 'not priced'). Price stays unknown.

HOOKUPS unconfirmed: the stored water + sewer (note prose, from a Lyon County listing) are not stated on any City of Inwood page, and the city policy says 'Sewer dumping shall occur only at approved facilities', which leaves sewer at the sites in doubt. Lyon County sites did not answer (connection failures), so the county listing stayed unread. Left as derived.

FIT unclear: no pad lengths posted; on imagery the four sites sit along a short gravel lane under heavy canopy. The form accepts motorhomes and fifth wheels. Keep; suggest caveat 'Pad lengths not posted; four shaded sites on a short lane.'
PRESENCE thin: Google lists 'Foote Park' with 5.0 from 1 review; RV Life has no listing. The city's own page and form are current (policy dated June 17, 2026).
Phone 712-753-4833 (City Hall) and website confirmed. Pin OK. Not waterfront (no water near).
